decision.title: CFTC public Commitments of Traders institutional positioning source
decision.summary: Authorize official CFTC Public Reporting COT datasets as a read-only observational institutional-positioning evidence family. Preserve TFF, Disaggregated, and Legacy report families separately. Enforce Futures Only vs Combined scope distinction to prevent double counting. PIT availability uses official 2026 release schedule where available and marks historical publication time uncertain otherwise. Capture is not admission. No smart-money score or copy-trade behavior.

alternatives.name: CFTC_COT_SEPARATE_EVIDENCE_FAMILY
tradeoffs: Weekly publication lag limits contemporaneous utility.
Contract-family aggregation requires explicit mapping to active contracts.

alternatives.name: THIRD_PARTY_COT_MIRROR
tradeoffs: Would violate official-source governance and PIT provenance requirements.

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: This ADR does not authorize automatic admission, predictive model training, smart-money scoring, copy-trade behavior, or conflation with whale identity tracking.

positive: Official aggregate participant-class positioning becomes queryable with PIT-safe availability.
TFF, Disaggregated, and Legacy categories remain distinct with provenance.
No credentials required for low-volume public API access.
negative: Weekly lag and aggregate categories limit individual-trader inference.
Historical exact release timestamps unavailable beyond published schedule window.
